contact.name: Jenny Martinez
contact.evidence_quote: Provost Jenny Martinez ... Jenny Martinez, a leading expert on international law and constitutional law and former dean of Stanford Law School, serves as Stanford’s provost – the chief academic and budgetary officer of the university. She assumed the position in October 2023 and has placed special emphasis on championing academic freedom and cultivating civil discourse on campus.
